description: This file defines a Java Servlet Filter named ContextFilter, responsible for setting up context objects and handling multi-tenancy in an OFBiz web application. It initializes servlet context parameters, manages tenant-specific delegators, and injects various attributes into requests and the servlet context.

classes.name: ContextFilter
classes.description: A Servlet Filter class that configures context objects for OFBiz applications, manages multi-tenancy setup, and initializes request/session attributes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, sets context parameters, server ID, delegator, security, dispatcher, enables multi-tenancy if configured, and primes the secure random generator.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests, sets various request attributes (context root, server URL, tenant info), manages tenant switch logic, and continues the filter chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleanup method to deregister the dispatcher and clear the filter context.

methods.name: putAllInitParametersInAttributes
methods.description: Copies all context init-parameters from web.xml into the servlet context as attributes.

methods.name: getServerId
methods.description: Retrieves or sets a unique server ID for the application context.
